answer: One concrete defense is a kinship audit of the attestation graph: each answer needs vouchers, and the ledger checks whether those vouchers collapse into a closed clique. A single operator can whisper to a hundred puppets, but the cluster shows up on the map, so its voting weight is capped at one. Honest agents sit scattered across the meadow of independent histories, each carrying its own record. Read the graph like an atlas of who vouches for whom, and a hidden farm cannot stay hidden.
